text: __NOTOC__ Axtroz is a red drake that guards the first inner gate of the valley leading to the gates of Grim Batol in the Wetlands. Emberstrife in Dustwallow Marsh would like Axtroz's skull.

Sergeant Bojorquez is a U.S. Marine in Call of Duty: World at War. He appears during Relentless. Bojorquez is first seen walking alongside a tank during the beginning of the mission. He then aids in the ensuing assault on the anti-tank position along with Pvt. Miller, Sgt. Roebuck, Pvt. Polonsky, Sgt. Griffith, Sgt. Penny and other Marines. Bojorquez, Griffith and Penny lack plot armor, with the trio usually dying during the assault at some point, although if he survives the assault, he will participate in taking out the other anti-tank gun. Bojorquez, Griffith and Penny will die regardless during the process of taking out the second anti-tank gun.

Aysa Cloudsinger is a pandaren and a master follower of the path of Tushui, which believes in living a venerable life through meditation, rigorous training, and moral conviction. She has attained impeccable form and a refined intellect through diligent practice. To Aysa, to follow the way of Tushui and to practice patience, is key to defending what is right. She believes that success in any endeavor never justifies dishonorable deeds. While the Alliance contains a diverse mix of cultures, Aysa is attracted to the high ideals and values that cement the Alliance together. After the Wandering Isle, Aysa can be found as a monk trainer near the Eastern Earthshrine, where her pandaren contingent have set up a permanent camp between the two waterfalls above Olivia's Pond.
Aviash is Lasan Skyhorn's eagle mount who accompanies him throughout Highmountain and elsewhere. During The Skies of Highmountain, Aviash transports the adventurer to Thunder Totem.
Ayala the Relentless is a warrior who cut down foe after foe in the pits of Valhalas on his way to legend. Becoming more lethal as his opponents weakened, he was truly terrifying to spectate.
The C9 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
__NOTOC__ Ayasanth is a red dragonspawn located at the Smoldering Perch in the Waking Shores.
Azure Scalebanes are blue dragonspawn found at the Azure Front in Crystalsong Forest. They can be found dead at the Violet Stand, seemingly killed by the Kirin Tor.
Azhuul'Mehab is a nerubian queen and a shaman in the Sundered Monolith. She was 48 years old when Brann met her.

The is an American military cargo transport aircraft used by the Allied Powers during World War II. It is seen exclusively in Call of Duty: WWII. The C-46 Commando appears in Multiplayer when playing as the Allied Powers when an Emergency Airdrop Scorestreak is called in. Its Axis equivalent is the BV 222 Wiking. It also appears when starting a game on the map Pointe Du Hoc were many C-46s being escorted by P-47s fly over the cliffs as the match begins.
Azika the Frostwitch was an orc frost mage found at the Dreadmaul Post in the Blasted Lands during the World of Warcraft: Warlords of Draenor beta.

__NOTOC__ Azoran was summoned by at the Broken Shore, and was later seen in Azsuna. He was a powerful eredar who commanded great rank within the Burning Legion. Azoran was the Legion general leading the operation in Felsoul Hold, and he planned to use the Burning Legion command ship, the Lightbreaker, to destroy Dalaran. An order leader worked with Lyana Darksorrow to undo Azoran's plans. They killed his most powerful lieutenants, and retrieved the key shards that could open the only portal to the Lightbreaker. While Lyana guarded the portal to prevent Legion reinforcements from intervening, the order leader boarded the ship and killed Azoran.
Azu is a frost wolf located at the Brewfest Grounds in Durotar.

The Bubble Shield is a Field Upgrade featured in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0. It was added on March 13th, 2026 as part of the Season Two Reloaded update of Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. It is found exclusively in the Black Ops Royale game mode. When thrown, the Bubble Shield will ignite a large dome to protect from explosions and weapon fire. After a certain amount of time or damage has been dealt to the shield, it will be destroyed. It can only be found as a ground loot.
Azure Warders are blue dragonspawn can be found in The Nexus.

__NOTOC__ Azurefall Guardian is a water elemental located in a river at Tel'anor in Suramar. It has been corrupted but was cleansed of rage by the class leader sent by Morhun Rivertamer. It left to tend to the water.

Bale Bleakstare is a farseer in service of the Horde. He is one individual who stands out among his forces: an old orc with white hair that frames his wizened face and keen eyes, and that flows in the wind. He wears totems of great power: animal fangs and claws, feathers of fierce birds, and blood-marked leather wrappings from wyverns and dragons. As the allies around him die, he smiles, not out of sadism but recognition - for spirits are more easily discerned by his aged eyes than the living.
The Bolt Carrier Group is a fire mod attachment featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
__NOTOC__ Baleflame is a red dragonspawn found at Vermillion Redoubt in the Twilight Highlands and inside the Grim Batol instance. Baleflame assisted in killing Obsidia.
Baelnor Lightbearer is an Alliance retribution paladin and is one of the possible opponents for Horde in the Faction Champions battle in the Trial of the Crusader raid instance.

Baelok is a vrykul death knight found in Malykriss: The Vile Hold in Icecrown. He reached his rank only through sheer brutality. Vereth the Cunning wants him killed for the quest The Rider of Blood. His steed is called Bloodsunder. Assuming to his title, he's teaching blood death knight abilities to the adepts, similar to Lord Thorval in Acherus: The Ebon Hold.

The Burst AC1-4 is a Barrel attachment available uniquely for the EX1 Assault Rifle in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It exchanges the fully-automatic beam fire mode of the standard EX1 for a 3-round burst that is able to be fired rapidly without the usual cooldown that the EX1 suffers. These shots are also much more damaging. However, this comes at the cost at being technically much more slower firing, having increased recoil alongside having a halved ammo capacity.
__NOTOC__ Baga the Frostshield is an ice troll located in Island Expeditions.
Bana Wildmane is a tauren flying mount vendor located at Thrallmar in the Hellfire Peninsula. She sells wind riders.
Banthar is the enormous clefthoof pack mother who roams the southern area of Nagrand. She is immune to Rooting and Chill effects.
Gun Rangefinder First Class Bunting was a member of the U.S. Navy who appeared in Call of Duty: World at War.

Baratea was a mere mage, and a recently invited member of the Kirin Tor, when the Scourge first appeared. She fought with the other members to defend the city from Prince Arthas and his legions, and fled with the others when Archimonde appeared. After Dalaran fell, the Kirin Tor scattered, but Baratea and many others returned to the ruins of their home. There, the other magi combed the city for survivors, for lingering undead, and for anything they could use. Despite her youth, Baratea is a powerful archmage of Kirin Tor. She is one of the leaders of the Kirin Tor.

Baron Charr was part of the periodic Elemental Invasions. When he appeared, he would yell, alerting everyone in Un'Goro Crater he had spawned. He spawned amidst a host of Blazing Invaders and was constantly escorted by some of his guards, circling the mountain counter-clockwise.

Battle-Mage Dathric is one of the four spirits that you can put to rest in Kirin'Var Village. He was once a male human mage who defended the village from intruders. He died when the village was destroyed by Kael'Thas forces. He can be found in the town hall. His spirit is anchored to the world by his sword. Putting his soul to rest will make the spirit towards you.
Browning could refer to either of the following weapons: *The Browning M2, or ".50 cal" *The Browning M1919 machine gun, or ".30 cal" *The Browning Automatic Rifle, or "BAR" *The Browning HP pistol.

__NOTOC__ .]] Battok the Berserker is an ice troll who leads the forces of the Frostmane tribe as they construct Frostmane Retreat. With the death of their chieftain at the hands of the troggs, the Frostmane turned to Battok, a well-respected warrior. He can be seen wildly dancing around a campfire at the center of the unfinished retreat. Once he reaches 50% health, Battok will transform into a dire troll.
Bazzil Frostweaver is a gnome ice cream vendor and member of the Cone of Cold located in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City during Children's Week.

Belkers are medium-sized elemental creatures of air living in both the Skywall of the Elemental Plane, as well as the Twisting Nether. In the air elemental hierarchy they reside just after revenants but before djinn nobles. They often travel as a group known as a clutch.
The CM901 is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. The weapon was first seen in the Special Ops reveal trailer.
Belath Dawnblade is a blood elf demon hunter of the Illidari. He commands scouts.

Beastmen are grotesque beings found in Drustvar that resemble beast (mostly pig) hybrids. They appear to be stitched together out of corpses of humans and animals, while Raal the Gluttonous used to be a human who was transformed by magic.

Belika is a young centaur hunter of Clan Shikaar encountered throughout the Ohn'ahran Plains. She is locked in a friendly rivalry with Aru over who is the better hunter; Belika believes that speed is more important than precision, while Aru believes the opposite. It's not specified if Belika and Aru are siblings or cousins, but they are both cousins to Initiate Aqira.
The CBJ-MS is a submachine gun that appears in Call of Duty: Ghosts.
Big Gladiator Chief is a hozen found at Dooker Dome in Kun-Lai Summit.
Big Bao is one of the strongest and determined disciples of the Order of the Cloud Serpent.

Bigfist is a sasquatch located at Gordunni Outpost in Feralas. He's being held by the Gordunni ogres, and is believed to being trained by them to unleash upon Camp Mojache. Bigfist is the largest sasquatch ever seen in Feralas. It's unknown if the other yetis in the area are indeed yeti or normal sized sasquatch.
The CLAW Flamethrower is a weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II. It is exclusive to the level "Fallen Angel".
Biggy Warprofits is a goblin flight master located at the in .
Bile-Eater is a carrion worm that turned undead by the corrupting blood of Spires of Arak. It was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.
Black Iron Siegebreakers are ogres located in the Hall of Blackhand of Upper Blackrock Spire.

The Cage is a utility in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare on the Exo Zombies map Carrier. It costs 1000 credits to use, and is part of the Easter egg Flotsam & Jetsam. In order to gain access to the cage, the player will have to destroy a flying drone, like the one that can be seen carrying power-ups after teleporting. After destroying this particular drone, a lever will be placed in the player's inventory. They will need to proceed to the lockers. After activating an audio cue, the player can go to the Moon Pool area, and insert the lever into a panel, which will allow the player to activate the cage. The player then needs to activate the cage, and kill a large number of zombies that are over the pool (thus putting blood into the water below). Soon after, a shark will appear. It is at this point the player must activate the cage a second time (one needs to have fished a red fish for this next part), and go into the cage after it drops into the water. Having the red fish in one's inventory, the shark will approach the player, and the player can swap the fish for an eyeball inside the shark's mouth. The cage will rise out of the water. After this, the player can access the locker previously visited, and continue towards the end of the Easter egg. Shark Attacking Cage AW.jpg|A Shark attacking the cage.
__NOTOC__ Blacklash is a black drake imprisoned along with his twin Hematus at the Lethlor Ravine in the Badlands. He is a former Lieutenant of Deathwing.

Blademaster Jubei'thos is a member of the Hellfire High Council, which serves as both a Highguard and a Council of War. He was the only one to have bested fellow council member Gurtogg by fighting him to a draw.

Blarus Whitrick, like most of his fellow Forsaken, hates the Scourge. The Lich King afflicted him with undeath, murdered his family, and destroyed his country. Blarus studied wizardry to gain personal power, all the while concocting plans to defeat the Scourge. Finally, he realized that only one force ever held control over the Lich King: the Burning Legion. Blarus knew that trafficking with demons was exceedingly dangerous, but could think of no better solution. So, he carefully studied warlock magic. Blarus planned to use the Legion to destroy the Lich King — or at least decimate the Scourge to the point where the forsaken could overcome it. Eventually, he realized he would need help, so he spread a few rumors that drew a handful of acolytes to his side. Unfortunately, these rumors also attracted the attentions of Varimathras, Undercity's dreadlord protector. Varimathras' forces raided Blarus' lab, and the warlock and his surviving apprentices fled the city. Blarus and his coven wandered for a time, avoiding forsaken patrols and searching for a new base. During this time, Blarus came into contact with Mael Shelub, a nerubian necromancer who seemed interested in defeating the Scourge. Mael offered his services to Blarus, who readily accepted. The group settled in Gaval Moch, a ruined castle in Silverpine Forest. Blarus' continued experiments again drew a dreadlord's attention. This creature was Ganthrifal, a nathrezim who had been skulking about Silverpine since the forsaken

The CC-12 is an assault rifle that appears in the Call of Duty: Black Ops III prequel comic. It is regarded as a high-standard weapon by Eamon Xu, who buys one from an arms dealer in Tashkent, favoring it over the KN-44. CC-12 BO3.png|Eamon holds a CC-12.

Blind Mary is a banshee who haunts an old farmhouse, known as Blind Mary's Haunt, on the southeast outskirts of Darkshire in eastern Duskwood. It is believed that Mary was once a beautiful woman who was killed by the undead of Duskwood, but still remained as a 'wraith' of her former self. Consumed by depression and anger over her fate of becoming such a monstrous being, she tore out her own eyes with her bare hands so that she would never have to see her hideous form again. After that, she threw out her precious looking glass.
Blisswing is a faerie located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Blood Elf Magisters are magisters found in Silvermoon City. One is seen siphoning a fel crystal at the Hall of Respite and going to a bookshelf. Others made residence beneath the Blood Knight headquarters where they were draining M'uru but then spent some time dazed after the theft of the naaru, still radiating residual holy energies. Back when they were draining M'uru, they needed very important and fragile equipment that sometimes required Blood Knight assistance in replacing. As of the Invasion of Pandaria, the ones under the Hall of Blood are probing a mogu artifact.

The CQB Bayonet (or Bayonet in development) is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered that was added in the December 13, 2016‎ update along with being featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered. It is only available through completing the CQB Bayonet bounty collection in the Depot. The CQB Bayonet is functionally identical to the Knife. However, unlike the Knife, the CQB Bayonet can be equipped in a matter similar to that of the Combat Knife featured in previous installments. The CQB Bayonet is also usable in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 Campaign Remastered, where it appears as the default melee weapon if the "Green Beret" Intel Cheat is enabled.

The Blood Knights are an order of blood elven paladins formed in Quel'Thalas in Year 25. The members of the order are referred to as blood knights, bloodknights, or simply knights. With the strong support of the Magisters and the blood elven guard force, the former of which had a hand in their creation, the Blood Knights rose from unproven and scorned beginnings to become a popular group within sin'dorei society. They are led by their matriarch, Lady Liadrin, who was the first of their order. Most Blood Knights were once members of the Royal Guard, proud defenders of high elven society. After the Third War, the vast majority of the high elves took up the name "blood elves" in honor of their slaughtered people, and in the wake of their ancient kingdom's destruction, many of the elves of Quel'Thalas came to view the Holy Light with contempt. This led to a great number of the blood elves losing their faith, and in turn, their Light-given powers, coming to believe that the Light had failed them in their homeland's hour of greatest need. When they needed a new way to access the Light, they sap the holy energy from the captive naaru M'uru, held beneath the Blood Knight headquarters. However, in a mad lust for power, Kael'thas Sunstrider sent the felblood to attack Silvermoon City and seize M'uru for his own personal uses. The Blood Knights vowed to aid A'dal and the Shattered Sun Offensive in defeating Kael'thas, Kil'jaeden, and restoring their homeland to its glory. With the Sunwe
Bloodaxe Evokers are orcs found in the Hall of Blackhand in Lower Blackrock Spire. They are part of the Bloodaxe Legion and specialize in damage-dealing fire and arcane spells.
__NOTOC__ Blood Priest Xak'lar is a blood troll located in the Lair of Xak'lar in Nazmir. She can be seen channeling blood magic into a Sick Riverbeast.

The CQB Breacher Device is a muzzle attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare. It is available to the Oden assault rifle, the AUG, Uzi, PP19 Bizon and Fennec submachine guns, and the PKM, SA87 and MG34 light machine guns.

Blood witches are powerful blood troll witches who specialize in the use of blood magic. They are known to chant and perform blood rituals. The witches in Zalamar were given talismans empowered by Hir'eek.
Bloodfeather was a ruthless harpy of the Barrens, who led her sisters to ruin many innocent wanderers of the Barrens of Kalimdor.

Bloodeye Redfist was an orc born into the Blackrock clan of the famous warchief Orgrim Doomhammer. His childhood was steeped in war. He lost his eye in battle when he was barely seven. He was found by Rehgar Earthfury in Booty Bay while he was being arrested by goblins. He was a hotheaded troublemaker, but he fought his would-be captors with skill and style. Rehgar saw his potential and bought him as a slave. When Thrall led the orcs to their new home across the Great Sea, Rehgar followed and brought Bloodeye with him to the red shores of the Barrens. As they traveled the fight circuit Rehgar trained Bloodeye to think as well as fight. Within three years he became the orcs' favored champion. A year before his death Bloodeye beat all comers in single combat. Rehgar and Bloodeye grew rich. Bloodeye bought his freedom but he wasn't ready to retire, so he and Rehgar pooled their funds to buy and train Broll Bearmantle and Valeera Sanguinar to join Bloodeye in team combat. But the day after Rehgar purchased Valeera, Bloodeye was poisoned by the mate of a fighter he slew in the arena. He did not die alone, however, as with his last breath he killed his assassin.
The is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.

Bloodfin Hydromancers are murlocs located in the Bloodfin Village in Nazjatar. They will hunt those who bring about the [https://www.wowhead.com/spell=295625/anger-of-the-bloodfin Anger of the Bloodfin].

__NOTOC__ Bloodeyes is a worgen located in Duskwood. During the Fourth War, the residents of Duskwood had been plagued by this particularly ferocious member of the Nightbane pack. Master Harris's sedative was used to bring the worgen back to Vassandra Stormclaw alive, who deemed her a perfect subject to test cures on.
__NOTOC__ Bloodmage Drazial is a blood elf quest giver found in Dreadmaul Furnace in the Blasted Lands. Like his sister Lynnore, he is a user of blood magic.
The CX-38E is a barrel attachment for the CX-9 submachine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone.
__NOTOC__ Bloodvenom is an unbound water elemental found imprisoned at Durnholde Keep in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Blue Dragonflight Recruiter is a blue dragonspawn located in the Quad in Algeth'ar Academy. She is accompanied by two Blue Dragonflight Alumni.

Bolvar Fordragon is the Highlord of the Knights of the Ebon Blade, and the former Lich King, who took up the position after the death of Arthas Menethil. Formerly a venerated paladin of the Alliance, Bolvar served as the Highlord and Regent of the kingdom of Stormwind following the disappearance of King Varian Wrynn. Upon Varian's return, Bolvar was named the commander of the Alliance forces sent to take the battle to the Scourge in Northrend. After the treachery of Grand Apothecary Putress at the Battle of Angrathar the Wrathgate, Bolvar was thought to have been killed by the Forsaken Blight. However, he was saved and reanimated by the flames of the red dragons but charred beyond recognition. Bolvar's body was altered by the dragons' flame, and was taken by the Scourge into Icecrown Citadel, where he was tortured by Lich King Arthas Menethil in an attempt to bend him to his will. However, the noble spirit of Bolvar resisted the Scourge lord's depravations. After the death of Arthas, Bolvar demanded that Tirion Fordring place the Helm of Domination on his bald, ashen head and turn him into the next Lich King to contain the threat of the Scourge. This imprisoned Bolvar within the Frozen Throne once more. After the Fourth War, however, Sylvanas Windrunner traveled to Icecrown Citadel to defeat Bolvar and destroy the Helm of Domination, ending his tenure as the Jailer of the Damned and opening the path to the Shadowlands.
The CX-23S is a barrel attachment for the CX-9 submachine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone.

Bogrogg the Stonescreamer is a drogbar and member of the Stonedark tribe who appears in the Hall of Chieftains in Thunder Totem after completing Unexpected Allies. He offers instant transportation to the Stonedark Grotto in northern Highmountain.
Bodalf the Strong is a vrykul who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.

In life Borivar was a male half-elf rogue. In death, the Scourge turned him into a wraith. This sinister, spectral figure is robed in tatters of darkness. It has no discernible features or appendages, but for the glowing red coals that are its eyes. He speaks Common and Thalassian.
The CX-23 is a barrel attachment for the CX-9 submachine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone.
Boscoe is a goblin located at the Llothien Highlands in Azsuna. Together with Rungle, he flies Boscoe and Rungle's Sky Chariot.
Boulderfist Magi are ogres of the Boulderfist tribe. They can be found in the southern part of the Arathi Highlands near the Thandol Span.
__NOTOC__ Boulderfall, the Eroded is an unbound earth elemental located in Blackbeak Overlook in Stormheim.
The CX-38 is a barrel attachment for the CX-9 submachine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone.
__NOTOC__ Bowline is a black drakonid located in Dragonbane Keep in the Waking Shores.

Brakor was a legendary orc hero of the in ancient times, when they were still enslaved by the ogres of Frostfire. He wielded the legendary spear Gronnsbane, which was blessed by the elements and beasts of the land, but which lost its power once leaving Brakor's hands. Brakor's first kill with the spear was when he proved his might by slaying one of the ancient black rylaks that inhabit the tallest spires of the Stonefury Cliffs, after which the weapon grew in power. Long after Brakor's death, Harrison Jones requested the aid of the commander to retrieve Gronnsbane for him by following the clues left by an orc sage called Argoram.
Bramok Gorewing is an orc flight master located at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.

The CX-38S is a barrel attachment for the CX-9 submachine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone. It increases the weapon's damage range, bullet velocity, and recoil control, all while keeping the gun sounds to a minimum, but at the cost of some mobility. The attachment restricts the ability to put Muzzle attachments on the weapon due to its integrated suppressor.
Brawler Otaka was an ankoan of the Waveblade clan. Otaka's fists spoke as loud as her words and silenced the boasts of Azshara's brutes. She lies buried at an Ankoan Burial Shrine in Nazjatar.
Branven Hammerheart is a dwarf ghost priest located in Exile's Reach. She helps the adventurer to learn Resurrection
Branch-Leaper the Swift is a night elf located in Verdant Wilds.
The CX-9 Clutch Grip is a rear grip attachment for the CX-9 submachine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone.

__NOTOC__ Brethlun the Brand is a Maw guard located in Zovaal's Cauldron in the Maw. Any Doomed Incarnation he comes across is quickly attacked, turning them into Stygian Souls. He wields one of Darion Mograine's swords.

Brine is an orc shaman located on a hill in the northern part of Blackthorn Ridge in the Southern Barrens. She is an expert on the spirits and nature of water, and previously aided trainee shaman adventurers in their quests to gain their water totem. When she was small, someone told her stories that even in times of great pain and sorrow, one can find a sliver of hope, a small symbol to rally around. At some point, Brine followed her companions into the Hillsbrad Foothills and fought against the humans living there, eventually arriving in Tarren Mill. While there, she found a small well of fresh spring water in the center of the town.
Brijana is a frost vrykul quest giver located in the Storm Peaks.
The CX-9 Ace Grip is a rear grip attachment for the CX-9 submachine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone.

Brightpaw summons the truly magical companion Brightpaw the Mana Kitty. Drawn to places teeming with arcane energies, you may find a creature with such an insatiable thirst for magic that only the most powerful - and patient of heroes could ever hope to tame it. No matter the dangers you face in your brave adventures, Brightpaw will stay by your side... more or less.
Brigita is a green dragonspawn located in the Roasted Ram in Valdrakken.
Bright Gustfeathers are ohuna located at Rhuzast's Roost in Thaldraszus. Most are found fighting Cloying Gales.
The CX-9 Tac Grip is a rear grip attachment for the CX-9 submachine gun in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone.
Brock Rockbeard is a Wildhammer dwarf gryphon flight master located at Stormfeather Outpost in the Hinterlands.

Broll Bearmantle is a talented druid and former gladiator who fought alongside and . He helped free Malfurion Stormrage from the Emerald Dream, and later organized the druid scouts in Darnassus. He is one of few night elves to have a pair of antlers, a sign of his great abilities as a druid. Unlike others, whose antlers grew in response to their growing power, Broll was born with them. Malfurion personally respects Broll as an equal.
Broodmother Dracasia is a black dragon located at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores.
The CX-MM is a stock attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone. It is uniquely available to the CX-9 submachine gun.
Broodguardian Ziruss is a red dragonspawn located in the Vault of the Incarnates.

The Brood Queen only appear in the Warcraft III map 'Monolith' and is seen as the hero for this race. It attacks land and air units, and because it is the only 'hero type' unit for the race, it comes free of charge but will cost the player five food, With the description "Capable of remaining motionless for years at a time, once roused the fury of the Brood Queen is unmatched". Its seen as a huge sized, Agility based Brood Mother, with a tint of purple in the skin. It is able to learn Impale, Carrion Swarm, Siphon Mana and Starfall. The Brood Queen also comes with Web, although it is unavailable due to it needs researched in the Undead Crypt.
Brulla is an orc shaman trainer located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. She is surrounded by a Water Shield. She defended the town during the Legion Invasions.
The CX-FA is a stock attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone. It is uniquely available to the CX-9 submachine gun.
Brusier Gor is an ogre who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Burning Treants are treants found in Firelands and the Molten Front.
Burning Hellions are imps located in Azsuna, the Broken Shore, and Antoran Wastes.
The CX-FR is a stock attachment featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare and Call of Duty: Warzone. It is uniquely available to the CX-9 submachine gun.
Buru the Gorger is a silithid colossus boss in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.

Byrok was an orcish warrior. A veteran of the First and Second Wars, he spent years enslaved in the humans' internment camps before being freed by Thrall. During the Third War a lesser demon claimed his right eye; in exchange Byrok had removed its entire head. Now free, he asked to be relieved of his service and happily became a simple fisherman instead. He wanted nothing to do with humans, considering them monsters and uncivilized creatures. While he was in Deadeye Shore, Byrok noticed six men nearby. It was revealed that they were members of Burning Blade. Byrok attacked them because he had heard that they wanted to kill Thrall. However, they overcame him and he started to run, but they caught him as he was injured. Later on, Byrok was found by Rexxar and Misha. They carried him to Orgrimmar where he told Thrall about the Burning Blade. He was then taken by shaman Kalthar to be healed. The shaman was sure he would survive.
Burnstachio is a djinn located at the Bizmo's Brawlpub and Brawl'gar Arena.
The CARV.2 is a bullpup tactical rifle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. It was added on May 6th, 2021 as part of the Season Three update.
Bursar Syleed is an ethereal likely planned to appear as part of the Trial of Style.

Calia Menethil of Lordaeron, styled "the Pallid Lady", is the daughter of King Terenas Menethil II and Queen Lianne, and the older sister of Prince Arthas. Once the princess of the fallen kingdom, she is now a member of the Desolate Council of the Forsaken after having been raised into undeath by the Holy Light. Calia survived the destruction of her homeland during the Third War and went into hiding for years, eventually reappearing as a priest alongside the undead Alonsus Faol during the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth. Hoping to reunite with her lost husband and daughter, whom she had become separated from during the Third War, Calia later worked with King Anduin Wrynn to organize the Gathering, where undead Forsaken could get the opportunity to reunite with their living human relatives. During the event, Calia was slain by the Forsaken's ruler Sylvanas Windrunner, but was subsequently resurrected as an undead infused with the Light under the guidance of the naaru Saa'ra. Alongside Derek Proudmoore, to whom she had grown close, Calia eventually joined the Forsaken, assisted in the reclamation of the Ruins of Lordaeron, and now serves as a member of the reformed Desolate Council governing the faction.

__NOTOC__ Caledra Dawnbreeze is a high elf located in the Petitioner's Chamber in Stormwind Keep. When the city was under the lockdown because of the infiltration from the Veiled Hand and the Uncrowned, Caledra stood guard in front of the Keep. As a master tracker, she could detect stealthed intruders. Around her were explosive traps.
The CBRS-3 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7. It was added as part of the Season Four update.
Calder is an elite frost giant blacksmith supplier found in Dun Niffelem in the Storm Peaks.
Caldara is a green dragonspawn located in the Central Encampment in the Emerald Dream.
Camilla Highwind is a dwarf flight master located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span.

The is an Italian bolt-action rifle featured in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One, and briefly seen in a trailer of Call of Duty: Black Ops. It was standard issue to Royal Italian Army troops during World War II.
Captain Grayson is a human ghost pirate captain located at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

Captain Crudbeard a dwarf death knight in service to the Stormpike Guard. In preparation for their assault to claim the Hillsbrad Foothills for themselves, Captain Crudbeard was stationed at the Headland. Crudbeard seems to prefer solitude as he threatens bodily harm to any who interprets him. After Horde adventurers disguised as a SI:7 insult his worth as a death knight he attacks and is subsequently killed in, as Melisara says, self-defense. Despite this, he defended the area during the Legion Invasions.
Captain Ironhill was the leader of Dun Garok. After the numerous forsaken attacks, all the dwarves fell (including Ironhill). His spirit now roams the grounds, trying to put his old comrades to rest.

is a weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, as well as in Call of Duty: Mobile under the name "Assault Pattern Camouflage". As the name implies, equipping it makes the weapon look like it's made out of carbon fiber.

Captain Nir'zan seems to be Khal'ak's right hand as she directed the Zandalari invading Pandaria. After revealing that Lieutenant Trag'kal and his men were met by trained defenders and killed during their attempt to take Zouchin Village Nir'zan and his men were ordered to have Trag'kal and the other fallen Zandalari's dead bodies stripped, skinned, filled with straw, and posted at either side of the village. Remarking that no pandaren would fear that sight, Khal'ak told him that the sight was intended to remind the Zandalari that the birth of an empire was going to be bloody. Following Chen Stormstout and Tyrathan Khort's scouting mission, which allowed them to acquire vital information in regards to the Zandalari's plan to resurrect Warlord Kao, Nir'zan was ordered to attack the Alliance and take as many prisoners as possible in order to discover the man's identity. An action that ultimately resulted in the capture of Vol'jin, Chen, Khort, and the Shado-pan when they attempted to stop the resurrection of the mogu warlord. After Vol'jin and his companions escaped the Isle of Thunder, Nir'zan was among the 500 that Khal'ak took with her to destroy Vol'jin and the others at the Shado-Pan Monastery. During the battle that followed, Captain Nir'zan engaged in battle against Vol'jin and was killed.

__NOTOC__ Captain Razorclaw is a worgen druid and captain in the Gilneas Brigade, serving on the Broken Isles trying to take over the Warden Towers located in either located in either Stormheim, Val'sharah, or Highmountain. Horde adventurers aid the Forsaken in attacking Razorclaw and the units she is responsible for. During the Fourth War, she was encountered by Horde champions in Nazjatar.
__NOTOC__ Captain Haab is a human ghost located in Azure Span.

Cannon Barrage is a Field Order Reward found exclusively on the map Mutiny. When activated, a pirate ship nearby will sail past and launch a barrage of cannonballs onto the map. The effect is similar to Mortar Fire and can kill the player who calls it in if they are not careful.

Captain Zorna is an elite orc captain of the Warsong Offensive, commanding the Horde forces in Venture Bay, Grizzly Hills. Baron Freeman of the Valiance Expedition describes her as a fierce fighter, and seek Zorna's death to weaken and disorganize the Horde forces in the harbor.
Captain Smoldersmitten is a goblin zeppelin captain of the Bilgewater Cartel located in the Twilight Highlands. He flies the Horde zeppelin from Dragonmaw Port to the Krazzworks.
__NOTOC__ Captain Zvezdan is a human ghost located at The Barnacle in Timeless Isle.

The Car Door is an item that appears in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It can be ripped off of unexploded cars with their doors open and used as a shield, and is discarded by throwing it. It cannot be picked up after throwing. After taking a sufficient amount of damage the player will automatically discard the door.

__NOTOC__ Cazul is an orc located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. He is a blind, ancient, and knowledgeable warlock. He was briefly seen during the Siege of Orgrimmar, standing in the Shadowdeep Reagents shop.
Caylais Moonfeather was a hippogryph flight master located in Auberdine in the night elven zone of Darkshore. She has since been replaced by Teldira Moonfeather in Lor'danel.

Catelyn Runeweaver, also known as Catelyn the Blade, is a human quest giver located in the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. She is the best knife fighter in Booty Bay, and was in her thirties just prior to the discovery of Pandaria. She is the daughter of Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver, a member of the Council of Six. Tired of a "boring life, reading over musty books and associating with grey-haired, stiff-backed, stuffy mages," she decided to join the Blackwater Raiders as a pirate. She eventually became the captain of the raider ship Neptulon's Bride. She was previously in a relationship with "Pretty Boy" Duncan, but ended it after discovering he was with the Bloodsails. He stole her knife as revenge, and she offers a quest to get it back.

Carma is a campaign-related achievement/trophy in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It requires the player to kill an enemy by throwing a car door at them. Carma XBOX One achievement image CoDAW.jpg|XBOX One Achievement Image
__NOTOC__ Cato is a blood elf paladin and a healer. He accompanies his friend Orik Trueheart to Shield's Rest to search the Tomb of the Old Kings for the Truthguard.
__NOTOC__ Cedonu is a blue dragonspawn of the Azurewing located in Leyhollow in Azsuna.
Cauteristrasz is a red dragon in Kul Tiran human visage located at Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.
Camille Denis, also known as Rousseau, is one of the protagonists and French resistance fighter featured in Call of Duty: WWII. She is playable in the first half of the mission Liberation.
__NOTOC__ Centaur Khans are centaur khan creeps that can be encountered in the Barrens tileset. They are the most powerful centaur found in melee games.

Chao the Voice is a level 90 Female Pandaren Warrior Shado-Pan member, who can assist you with Shado-Pan daily quests after completing the quest The Challenger's Ring: Chao the Voice. According to Master Snowdrift, her title is due to being very boisterous in battle. Her abilities indicate she is an Arms warrior. Chao can be seen on the Timeless Isle, overlooking the Celestial Court.
Charged Gales are air elementals located in Stormsong Valley.

The was a 155 mm cannon used by the French Army during the first half of the 20th century. Following the French surrender, the captured 155mm GPF guns were obtained by the Wehrmacht, and reclassified as the '15.5-cm K 418(f)'. Having been originally introduced in 1917, the captured pieces were usually relegated to coastal defense or heavy artillery battalions. By 1944, over 50 guns were emplaced on the beaches of Normandy.
Charfrost Flamebelchers are fire elementals located in the Azure Span.
Chief Ogg'ora was a female ogre mage and a leader of the Fire-Gut ogres.

__NOTOC__ Chill Nymphs are frost nymphs located in the Chill Glade of Howling Fjord. They became corrupted when the glade fell to an unknown magic turning them evil. Lurielle tasks players with freeing them so they can travel back to her.

The Cargo Truck is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 4, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Mobile, Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III, Call of Duty: Black Ops 6, Call of Duty: Black Ops 7, and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4.
Chinley Chang is a pandaren seen meditating in Warspear's goblin section of Ashran.

Chromaggus is a two-headed dragon beast creation of Nefarian, who acts as a dutiful protector of Blackwing Lair. Despite his canine appearance, he's actually a dragonkin (more specifically a drakeadon). Chromaggus is a boss coming after Flamegor and before Nefarian. One of the most challenging aspects to Chromaggus is the randomness of his abilities. Chromaggus shimmers in a variety of colors, which relate to his current abilities. These abilities are determined upon instance creation, and will only be reset with the instance timer. He drops the Tier 2 shoulders for all classes.

Cho'Rush the Observer is an ogre mage in Dire Maul North. The helper and healer of King Gordok in the last fight of Dire Maul North. He acts like Moira Bronzebeard in the last fight of the Blackrock Depths — when you kill the main boss, he will become to you (and even apologize!)
The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. It was added as part of the Season Five update.
__NOTOC__ Churn is a water elemental and the leader of the water elementals in the Blistering Pool in the Borean Tundra.
Chydrass is a black dragonspawn located at the Obsidian Throne in the Waking Shores.
Clattering Coldwraiths are skeletal mages that can be found in the Dawning Wood Catacombs of Duskwood.
The Carbon 57 is a submachine gun featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.
Cliffclutch Matriarch is a harpy located on Cliffclutch Roost in Suramar.
Cleaver Northamel is a mo'arg brute that accompanied the Felskorn to the gates of the Hall of Valor. He was taken out by the champions of the Silver Hand who collected his blood.
Clearlake was an unbound water elemental located in the Everbloom. It guarded a strange oil-producing plant. It was taken out by the followers sent from the garrisons.
The Camper is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 where it is available in the DMZ mode.
__NOTOC__ Cloaked Shadowraiders are arakkoa located in Tanaan Jungle.

Yor'sahj the Unsleeping calls to the might of Shu'ma, summoning three differently colored globules of his blood. These globules path slowly towards Yor'sahj, infusing him with additional powers if they reach him. When a Cobalt Globule reaches Yor'Sahj, it infuses Yor'sahj with the ability to summon Mana Voids.
Coilskar Assassins are Coilskar naga located in Shadowmoon Valley during Escape from Coilskar Cistern.

Carbine can refer to: *The M1 Carbine, a semi-automatic rifle *The M2 Carbine, an automatic rifle *The MK2 Carbine, a lever-action marksman rifle *The M4A1/M4 Carbine, an assault rifle *The Cooper Carbine, an assault rifle *The Commando, an assault rifle, known as "Carbine" in Black Ops: Declassified *The SPBC (Special Purpose Battle Carbine), an assault rifle *The Karabin, a semi-automatic sniper rifle *The Kar98k (Karabiner 98k), a bolt-action rifle *The 16.5" Factory Carbine, a barrel attachment *The FSS Carbine Pro, a barrel attachment *The FTAC C6 Carbine PRO, a stock attachment *The Holger-26K Double-Stack Carbine Mag, a magazine attachment *The .30 Carbine Mags, a magazine attachment

:"Ummm…what is that?" Collidus the Warp-Watcher is an elite rare mob observer that can be found wandering throughout Shadowmoon Valley. Its primary abilities include a melee for approximately 2K on plate, a random AoE fear (which is very likely to cause adds in a populated zone), and a channeled beam that inflicts 400-500 damage per second of random types.

Colborn the Unworthy is a vrykul ghost located in Helheim. After an adventurer and Ashildir were banished to Helheim, they found him in a cage and freed him. He then asked adventurers to get seaweed for a disguise to pass Guarm. It's unknown what happened to Colborn after.

Commander Mar'alith is a night elf quest giver located at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. He is currently the head of the Cenarion Circle forces in Silithus. Although he is grieving due to the loss of his wife, Natalia Mar'alith, he is strong and commands his forces to fight the silithid. He has become a little absent-minded these days after receiving a message, about the death of his wife, brought by an agent. He wears a full Battlegear of Might and wields the Grand Marshal's Glaive.

Lieutenant Charles “Chuck” Walker was an American soldier who fought during World War II, he was assigned to Able Company. Lt. Walker is the playable character in the American campaign for Call of Duty: Finest Hour. He was good friends with Benny Church.
Colossal War Wraith is a ghost elemental encountered by adventure companions in Maldraxxus.
__NOTOC__ Conflago is a blue dragon alchemy trainer located at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken. They swap between a female and male visage form every in-game day.

__NOTOC__ Conjurer Luminrath can be found in the Netherstorm. He is an high elven mage who died defending Kirin'Var Village against Kael'thas' forces. Before his death, he would conjure food for his fellow mages.
The , or M1924/29, is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One and Call of Duty: WWII.

Conjurer Tyren is a blood elf mage found in Silvermoon City. He wanders around southwestern Silvermoon, going from the Walk of Elders to the Bazaar, occasionally using fireworks and casting Evocation.
Confusion Manifest is an air revenant located at Algeth'era Court in Thaldraszus. It is only visible while under the effect of the Curious Glyph.
Consular Celestos is an air elemental located in the Heart of Azeroth.
The Choco Camouflage is a type of weapon camouflage skin in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 and Call of Duty: Black Ops II.

Corrupt Living Waters are sha-corrupted water elementals found at the Fountain of the Everseeing in the Temple of the Jade Serpent. When destroyed, several Corrupt Droplets appear from them. They are also seen putting something into the waters of the fountains.
__NOTOC__ Corin Moonfall is a night elf ghost located in Zin-Azshari in Nazjatar. He will offer his services after On Ghostly Wings has been completed.
Corrupted Spirits were ghosts located in Scholomance during Judgment and Redemption and The Darkreaver Menace.

The Chicom CQB (referred to as the QCW-05 in the game files) is a bullpup submachine gun that appears in Call of Duty: Black Ops II and Call of Duty: Mobile. It was first seen in the Los Angeles Gameplay Trailer. In-game, it delivers high cyclic fire rate and is a three-round burst weapon.
Corven the Wicked is a spectre located in the Hungering Wastes in the Maw.
__NOTOC__ Countess Verrall is a water elemental affiliated with the Earthen Ring. She inhabits Loch Verrall of the Twilight Highlands.

Cote "Shepherd" Metcalf is a human mage standing in front of the entrance of the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest, he is the final obstacle, as well as the owner of The Woolomancer's Charge and can only be found if the mage hunting for the hidden artifact appearance has completed the previous requirements. He was kicked out of the Tower of Azora by Theocritus, who branded him as insane. When a mage talks to him, waves of Enraged Elwynn Sheep and Enraged Volatile Elwynn Sheep appear to swarm him down. After protecting him, a lumberer named Craig Ryan V appears and tries to warn the mage that Cote is a maniac who transformed the former's entire family into sheep. Cote polymorphs Craig into a sheep and then turns his staff on the player. He is killed in the ensuing onslaught and his staff taken from his body.
The Chain SAW is a light machine gun featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts and Call of Duty: Mobile.

Cox is a large human and the partner of the famous detective Halford Ramsey. Together, Cox and Halford were investigating the Starlight Slasher murders; however, the two of them did not get along. Halford's cold logical view of the world angered Cox, especially when he began treating corpses without the respect a dead human deserves. Cox displayed happiness when Halford punched him, saying he had been waiting a long time for them to fight. Cox and Halford discovered a Wolf Cult ritual in an antique shop at Gilneas City, and Halford pursued their suspects into the Blackwald before being attacked by a worgen. Cox later delivered news of Halford's apparent death to King Genn Greymane. When the worgen attacked Gilneas in force days later, Cox was revealed to be a servant of Alpha Prime and a member of the Wolf Cult. His status afterwards is unknown.
Cravat is a black dragonspawn located in Dragonbane Keep in the Waking Shores.

Crenna Earth-Daughter is a tauren located in Exile's Reach. She and several other Exile's Reach survivors end up on Khaz Algar joining incomplete hero parties to take on dungeons. She fills the role of restoration druid and healer.
Circuit Personalization Pack is a downloadable content package available for Call of Duty: Ghosts. It contains a weapon camo, reticle, a player background and a player patch.
Crimsastrasza is a red dragon in a blood elf visage located in Algeth'ar Academy in Thaldraszus.

.]] .]] The crystal dryads are a race of crystal-like dryads or frost nymphs in Crystalsong Forest, the Nexus, Suramar, and Bonich. The crystal dryads of Northrend were created when the Highborne of Shandaral stole and attempted to use magic from the blue dragonflight to disastrous results. The spell crystalized almost all life within Crystalsong Forest, then known as Moonsong Forest, leaving the survivors as half-crystalized creatures. Some of these dryads appear to be affiliated with the remnants of the Highborne, who were transformed into the crystal satyrs, under the Unbound. Some crystal dryads can be found lurking in the Singing Grove of the Nexus, where they watch over the arcane plant life. The shardmaidens of the Shattered Locus are dryads who were twisted by the magic of the failed arcan'dor.
Crystalspire Stone Drake is a stone drake located in the Twilight Precipice in Deepholm.
Champion Camouflage is a weapon camouflage in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. It is unlocked upon the purchase of the Championship Premium Personalization Pack.
Crystalwing Stone Drake is a stone drake located in Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.
__NOTOC__ Daelyshia is a night elf hippogryph flight master located at Astranaar in Ashenvale. She would later be killed by the Horde. The signs show that she was at least poisoned.

__NOTOC__ Da Cabin Boy is an undead dire troll located in the northwestern Port of Zem'lan in Vol'dun. He holds the Idol of Immortality, one of the three idols that were used by Pirate-King Zem'lan to curse his crew into skeletons.

Chompy is a utility in the Exo Zombies map Carrier in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. Chompy is an automated lawnmower that can be located in the Cargo deck of the map, where it can be activated manually, through the Security power-up, or by activating the wall buy. When it appears, Chompy will circle around the Cargo deck, mowing down zombies in its path. Both zombies and players can climb on top and stand on Chompy as it moves. An achievement titled "Take Off, Hoser!" requires the player to ride Chompy for a total of five minutes in a single match. In the aftermath of Flotsam & Jetsam, Chompy is destroyed by the ensuing explosion caused by the four survivors.

__NOTOC__ Daeth Moonshade is a night elf druid and member of the Army of the Black Moon. During the Fourth War, Daeth would take part in the Battle for Darkshore to drive the Forsaken and Horde from the night elves' homeland. On the battlefield, he took charge of Lornesta Mine in the south, protecting Alliance iron production for the war effort.

__NOTOC__ Daelya Twilightsbane is a blood elf ghost paladin located at the Darkmaul Plains on Exile's Reach. When the Horde's second expedition came to the island, she approached Grunt Throg and asked him to send the group's novice paladin to see her. She granted the paladin Divine Shield as a boon from the Light, so they could reach a nearby Necrotic Altar and destroy it. With her final task fulfilled, Daelya's spirit was called to the Light.

Daio the Decrepit is an elderly human warlock who trains young recruits in the infernal arts, found at an altar in the northern part of the Tainted Scar in the Blasted Lands. He was once a member of the Kirin Tor, but was exiled after helping Arrexis conduct a ritual that accidentally summoned the eredar mage-hunter Balaadur and resulted in the massacre of Arrexis and his mage followers. The disaster caused Daio to give up the arcane and instead begin a personal quest to understand demons and their fel energies. Frost mages in search of Ebonchill seek out Daio at the Tainted Scar to learn more about Arrexis' fate. Before Daio agrees to help the mage with recreating the disastrous ritual, he has them fight several of his demons in order to see if they are as capable as they claim. Once the mage defeats all of Daio's minions, he gives them a Demon Stone from Balaadur's home realm in order to better attune their ritual to demonic energies.
China Spring is a weapon camouflage skin featured in Call of Duty Online. It was added in an April update.
Dalliah the Doomsayer is a female shivarra demon, and the third boss of the Arcatraz in Tempest Keep. This can also be done as the second boss before Wrath-Scryer Soccothrates.
Dak Dak is the high legend chief of the Broketooth hozen in Kun-Lai Summit.
__NOTOC__ Dark Conclave Ravenguard are arakkoa ghosts found in Shadowmoon Valley.

A Catapult is an ancient weapon used to throw rocks across large distances, and was seen during the time of Ancient Rome. It would have seen usage in Call of Duty: Roman Wars, where flaming ammunition could have been used.

A darkglare is a floating, horned, one-eyed or five-eyed octopus-like demon similar to an observer. Little is currently known about them. Affliction warlocks can call forth a darkglare to aid them in battle using the Summon Darkglare ability.
Darkfur the Smasher is a wendigo located in Island Expeditions.

__NOTOC__ Darkspeaker R'khem is a n'raqi quest giver located inside the Saronite Mines in Icecrown. Having been chained by the vrykul, he offers the quest Mind Tricks. After completing the quest, he will disappear, making noises that translates as laughter in the player's mind. It was present during Death Rising.

Celerity is an Epic gun perk in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It grants the weapon an increased fire rate when hipfiring, with a decreased fire rate when aiming. It only appears on the NV4 - Chaos.variant.
Darkshadow the Omen is a wind serpent located in Island Expeditions.
Darkwraiths are shades that roam the Dead Scar between the river and the path that leads to the Ghostlands.
Dasnurimi is a bronze dragonkin found in the Wyrmrest Temple of Dragon Soul. She was killed during the assault. After Morchok is killed she is revived.
The Caveman is a melee weapon that was added to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered on the May 2nd, 2017 update. The weapon resembles a combat knife made from flint.
Dealer Digriz is an ethereal general goods vendor located at the Stormspire in the Netherstorm.
__NOTOC__ Death's Door Charm has the user take on a spirit form for 30 minutes. The effect is similar to the one that happens to adventurers in Helheim.
__NOTOC__ Tall, gaunt undead, the Death Knight appears more like a normal human than most undead. Heavily armored, they swing two-handed swords.
The is a melee weapon featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare Remastered, Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and Call of Duty: Black Ops 6. It also makes a brief appearance in Call of Duty: Black Ops.

Death Speaker Jargba is a quilboar found in Razorfen Kraul. Jargba is a Death Speaker, a prophet of the Quilboar religion which preaches their fallen god Agamaggan will rise from the dead. As such, he is a combination of priest and powerful warrior.

Deathbringer Saurfang is the fourth boss in the Icecrown Citadel raid. He is described as being the Lich King's most powerful death knight. It's mainly a DPS race with an interesting twist (Blood Power). After falling to Frostmourne at the Battle of Angrathar the Wrathgate, Dranosh Saurfang was raised in undeath by the Lich King and brought to Icecrown Citadel. Imbued with the power of the Scourge, the Deathbringer bars the way of any attackers trying to enter the Upper Spire.

A death ritual is a ritual where a spirit is invoked. It is not an overly complex rite. Knowing that death is merely the shadow of life the shaman Kador Cloudsong asked the Spirit of Life, the element inside of every living being, to invite one who walks in its shadow to the living world.

The Cavalry Division is a Division featured in the multiplayer of Call of Duty: WWII added in the United Front update. The Division offers a Shield in place of one's primary weapon, and its abilities that are granted via leveling up the division are focused on supportive, objective play, rather than combat benefits as with other divisions. The Cavalry Division features a pseudo-Rifleman Basic Training, as the shield takes up the class' primary weapon slot, with the player being able to select any other weapon to be their secondary weapon, including primary weapons. However, the primary weapon selected cannot equip any attachments. Activities such as escorting the tank in War Mode will grant 15 score every few seconds, and reaching a tank checkpoint will grant 50 score. Building (walls, turrets or hedgehogs) will be faster.

The Death Metal Knight is a death knight who is the enemy of the Blight Boar band. He will spawn during their concert and the surrounding group can attack him. He spawns waves of banshees that the player needs to dodge, ghouls to kill, and has a Frost-school damage aura, so a healer is advised.

__NOTOC__ Deathweb Egg Tenders are demonic creatures. Their venom twists the very form of their victims and so the 's warlocks were dispatched to infuse them with fel energy so that their venom transforms their victims into demonic minions.

Deep sea murlocs, also called deep murlocs, are a species of -like murloc that lives in the ocean depths, in locations such as Vashj'ir and the Throne of the Tides. They possess long, sharp fangs and phosphorecent antennae which they use to lure fish out of the reeds. Larger individuals hunt for fish in the kelp, while the smaller ones practice some kind of magic.

Center Mass is a weapon perk featured in the Nazi Zombies mode of Call of Duty: WWII. Its function is the complete opposite of the Precision weapon perk, instead doing increased damage to the body while lowering the amount of damage inflicted to the head.
Defias Renegade Mages are humans found in southern Westfall.

Defias Blood Wizards are wizards in the service of Vanessa VanCleef. They are found in the tunnel after the Goblin Foundry and before Ironclad Cove, and during the fight Vanessa in the Deadmines. They use blood magic.

The Defiant Devilsaur is found surrounded by a handful of Master Callers and a Zandalari Fetish-Binder at the northeastern end of the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder. Should all of the devilsaur's handlers mysteriously fall over dead, the devilsaur will break free and wreak havoc on the rest of the bestiary.
Close Quarters is a weapon perk featured in the Nazi Zombies mode of Call of Duty: WWII. With this perk, players will be rewarded an extra bonus to the player's Special Ability meter.

The Defiant Riverbeast is a huge riverbeast standing in the central pool in Whistlebloom Oasis in Vol'dun. It constantly protects the two Thirsty Calves in the pool behind it; whenever a pair of Whistlebloom Impalers periodically approach the pool, the riverbeast will drive them away by stomping the ground.

Delas Moonfang is a powerful night elven priestess of the moon of the Sisterhood of Elune and a paladin of the Order of the Silver Hand. She was first encountered at Starfall Outpost in on , and later moved at the Netherlight Temple and in the Sanctum of Light beneath Light's Hope Chapel. During the war against the Iron Horde, she traveled with the Alliance forces in Draenor and helped them to fight the fel corruption in the woods surrounding the garrison of Lunarfall. At the time of the third invasion of the Burning Legion, she joined the Conclave and deciphered Balnazzar's attack plans against the Netherlight Temple. During her researches, she met the Highlord of the Silver Hand who later saved her from the Burning Legion on the demon world of Niskara. At the request of Alonsus Faol, she managed to convince the paladin order to create an alliance with the Conclave to destroy the nathrezim. After she found her true path in the Light, Delas officially became the first night elf paladin and champion of the Silver Hand.

Degar Bloodtotem is a Highmountain tauren of the Bloodtotem tribe who appears in the Bartering Cave at Spiritwatch Point in Highmountain during The Eagle Spirit's Blessing. Using lashers and plant tentacles to attack the Point, Degar has imprisoned the Wild God Ohn'ahra inside the Bartering Cave in an attempt to subjugate her and discover the location of Talonclaw in order to claim it for the Bloodtotem. When Apata Highmountain and a hunter adventurer fly to Spiritwatch in search of Ohn'ahra, Degar pulls Apata down into the cave with his magic and imprisons her as well, forcing the hunter to journey into the cave and kill Degar.
The Chaos is an assault rifle featured in Call of Duty Online. It is able to switch between assault rifle and light machine gun mode.
__NOTOC__ Defilia is a harpy located at Skyhorn in Highmountain.

Demon Portal Guardian is a felguard in charge of guarding the demon portals in southern Desolace from being destroyed. When someone attempts to do so, they come through the portal to attack the offender.
Derek Rammel is a human flight master located at Fordragon Hold in the Dragonblight.
The is a primary weapon featured in Call of Duty: WWII and Call of Duty: Vanguard. It also appears within Finishing Moves in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6.
__NOTOC__ Depths Overseer are ogre mages located in the Twilight Highlands.
Deviate Flapper is a wind serpent located at in the Wailing Caverns during the Wailing Critters scenario.

Dia Darkwhisper, a champion of Void magic and an outcast of the Shadowmoon, rose quickly to power and became the left hand of . She is now apart of the Hellfire High Council, which serves her master as both a Highguard and a Council of War.
Cha-Ching is a melee weapon that was added to Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 with the Operation Grand Heist update.

Diabolic Tauren are large, aggressive tauren found in the "Secret Cow Level", a special phased version of the Yorgen Farmstead in Duskwood available during Diablo's 20th Anniversary. They are led by the infamous Cow King.

Hostile= |-| Friendly= __NOTOC__ Dihar the Unyielding was a famous centaur archer of Clan Teerai and a companion to Tsegzaya, the first daughter of Teera. Dihar named her bow after Tsegzaya; she fired countless arrows with it, felling both wild game and the enemies of Clan Teerai. According to legend, no centaur ever fired as many arrows as Dihar. Clan Ukhel exhumed Dihar's bow in order to raise and enslave her spirit, and a hostile version of her now roams a dell on the eastern side of the main kurgan in the Eternal Kurgans. Initiate Zorig asks adventurers to help him defeat Dihar and use the :Totem of Respite to release her soul and help her find her way back to her own kurgan. A separate, friendly version of Dihar is located in roughly the same area, running back and forth in a wide half-circle in front of the kurgan. This version of her is normally invisible and can only be seen while the player character is under the effect of Essence of Awakening. Gifting her 5 Writhebark is required for Honor Our Ancestors.

Dirt eaters are concept undead creatures seen only in one piece of concept art by Blizzard artist Travis Thammer. They may have been a canceled unit type for Warcraft III. Based on the caption, dirt eaters are half buried in dirt when moving around. They seem to attack by throwing rocks.
The Chord Muzzle Brake is a Muzzle attachment available for all Assault Rifles and the DP27 light machine gun in Call of Duty: Vanguard. It gives a slight increase to the weapon's accuracy.

Knight-Champion Dirk Longfellow was a human who fought during the Second War. As a member of Kul Tiras, he was part of the marine army whose battles were all at sea. While on the Drustvaria, he would die during the Battle of Crestfall when red dragons breath fire on their vessels, sending their ships to the bottom of the sea. In the present day, he is one of the Drowned Sailors.
Dismauld is a human ghost located in the Forgotten Cove in Stormsong Valley.
Dislodged Shardlings are earth elementals located in Thaldraszus.

Christina, also known as Tempest, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on September 23, 2022, during Season 8: Train to Nowhere as part of the Altered Reality Draw. Tempest also appears in the Comics.
Dockmaster Kazibo is a Zandalari troll located on a ship in Xibala in Zuldazar. He is seen speaking with Third Telemancer Syranel. When Syranel was attacked, she teleported Kazibo away.

Donna is a human girl found running in the Trade District and the borders of Cathedral Square, Old Town, and Dwarven District in Stormwind City. Before the Cataclysm, she was chasing William because he stole her doll, Betsy. Since Cataclysm, Donna is now being chased by William for stealing his mechanical gorilla.
Doomra, the Ever-Living is a raised night elf in the Black Rook Hold. He was taken out by the champions of the class orders. He is believed to be a long-deceased member of the Ravencrest family.

The Chop Top is a vehicle featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III. In Modern Warfare II and Modern Warfare III, the Chop Top is available for use in Multiplayer in the Ground War and Invasion game modes and in the DMZ mode. In Modern Warfare III, it is available for use in the Zombies mode on the experience Operation Deadbolt.
